videos.title: Elon Musk Will Give SpaceX Shares to ‘Every Kid in America’
videos.description: Elon Musk says he will gift a share of SpaceX to each American child, in a post on X, the social media platform he owns. The move comes just hours after artificial intelligence competitor Anthropic PBC said it would set aside a portion of its shares for the public benefit. Matt Bloxham of Bloomberg Intelligence has more. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
